verdict.rationale: Grafana is published as open source on GitHub (grafana/grafana), and its docs are titled 'Grafana OSS and Enterprise'. Community threads discuss its AGPLv3 license for internal use, and the docs describe migrating from self-run Grafana Enterprise to Cloud. Companion components are also self-runnable, such as Loki as a local single binary and the self-managed open source MCP server. Missing for 10: explicit first-party installation/deployment docs for self-hosting Grafana itself, and hands-on corroboration of running a self-hosted instance.
